verdict.rationale: HMRC runs online services and a production API that hold user data, so data residency is a fair privacy-posture question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage location, region selection, or residency controls; the items cover only tax registration, Making Tax Digital sign-up, and API and robots probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
